# Tasks: Native Rust/GPUI Comfy parity

Every checkbox is an independently executable implementation leaf. Wave numbers are computed from explicit dependencies. Tensor/operator, device, model, sampler, scheduler, latent, and node breadth leaves in the same wave use disjoint Rust modules, fixtures, and lab records; generated module manifests let each leaf compile without editing a shared root, and serialized integration leaves own central closure output. No task launches or connects to ComfyUI in production code.

Repository validation uses `./script/clippy`, never `cargo clippy`. Task-specific tests supplement, not replace, the strict spec and closure gates.

CPU and Apple Metal are the certified baseline backends. Signed CPU attestation creation/refresh and live observations for optional accelerators are external release-certification gates, not executable task checkboxes. CoreX implementation beyond the compiled fail-closed typed-Unbound structural adapter is owned by `.agents/specs/comfy-corex-enablement/`.

Evidence retained beneath an unchecked task is historical pre-reopen evidence only. It does not satisfy completion after a normative design, ownership, implementation, or validation change; the task must receive fresh post-change evidence before its checkbox may be restored.

- [x] 2. Create the native Comfy crate and worker foundation
  - _id: comfy-parity-native-crate-foundation
  - Outcome: One serialized foundation change registers the native runtime crates and the single dev-only oracle owner in `comfy_test_support`, and pins the selected `half`, `bytemuck`, `rayon`, `postcard`, Wasmtime Component Model, GPUI/workspace, filesystem-watcher, and other workspace/local dependencies required by the pre-vendor foundation and ownership-consolidation tasks. `comfy_plugin_host` has explicit normal dependency edges to `comfy_types`, `comfy_runtime`, `comfy_nodes`, and `extension_host`, while Zed predeclares the normal dependency edge that Task 21 must consume during production bootstrap; neither an unused edge nor test-only construction is evidence that host integration is complete. `comfy_tensor` declares `cpu` as the default and declares `cuda`, `rocm`, `metal`, `directml`, `xpu`, `npu`, `mlu`, and `corex` as forwarding features to eight local adapter crates; `comfy_test_support` forwards the same features while retaining CPU through its normal runtime test dependencies. The adapter crates initially contain only typed unavailable stubs, so this task does not guess vendor crates, headers, symbols, link rules, SDK paths, licenses, or package payloads. Later backend-foundation leaves own those decisions and their disjoint Cargo/build/package files. Tensor/model/sampler/node build scripts scan the planned disjoint source directories and generate sorted compile-time includes plus module manifests for breadth files.

  - _id: comfy-parity-protocol-foundation
  - Outcome: Versioned Rust types preserve exact source identifiers, schemas, unknown fields, binary frames, prompt/attempt identity, typed worker lifecycle acknowledgements, bounded typed registry-deployment rejections, 16 MiB private worker frames, and 4 MiB encoded application events. `comfy_types::CancellationToken` is the sole cooperative cancellation-state owner; tensor, plugin, API-headless, and API-transport layers retain only checked domain/reason adapters over that token.   - _id: comfy-parity-vendor-dependency-lock
  - Outcome: In one serialized workspace mutation, finalize all eight adapter dependency lists, the matching optional `comfy_runtime` backend features, and the disjoint worker/test-support/host forwarding matrix before any ABI foundation runs. Reuse the root workspace as the sole third-party version/feature owner, `comfy_types` as the device/binding domain owner, `comfy_tensor` as the semantic backend/capability owner, and `comfy_runtime::NativeFfiRegistry` as the sole certificate issuer; keep each `comfy_backend_*` crate a focused vendor adapter rather than a parallel generic subsystem. The private worker alone combines `comfy_runtime/<backend>` with `comfy_tensor/<backend>`, test support selects only tensor conformance, and host Zed selects only runtime/profile presentation. Common adapters use the workspace `anyhow`, `serde`, `serde_json`, and `thiserror`; Linux C-ABI loaders and the runtime retained-descriptor adapters use workspace `libc`; Metal uses workspace `metal` 0.33 and `objc` 0.2; DirectML extends the existing workspace `windows` 0.61 entry and requests only the D3D12, DXGI, library-loader, COM, WinTrust signature, and foundation features required by D27. No adapter uses bindgen or downloads an SDK at user build time. Regenerate Cargo.lock once and write a machine-readable package/dependency/target/feature/ownership/reason ledger; subsequent tasks may not change dependency sections, feature forwarding, or Cargo.lock.

- [x] 135. Consolidate Unix native-library image capture and sealing
  - _id: comfy-parity-unix-native-library-image-owner-consolidation
  - Outcome: Before the final Wave 39 execution-owner audit and further NPU breadth, replace the duplicated MLU and ROCm Unix native-library descriptor capture, cancellable digest, immutable memfd sealing, and retained loader-image lifetime implementations with one crate-private comfy_runtime::trust owner. CapturedNativeLibraryImage alone owns the bounded nonempty O_NOFOLLOW regular-file read, descriptor identity and metadata stability checks, cancellable SHA-256, and immutable bytes. RetainedNativeLibraryImage alone owns the sealed descriptor lifetime and loader path; CapturedNativeLibraryImage::seal alone performs cancellable copy, rewind, F_ADD_SEALS, exact-seal verification, and path creation. MLU and ROCm retain only focused target, discovery-root, signed-contract, ABI, ELF, dependency-graph, certificate, DTO, and typed-error mappings. DirectML remains an explicitly justified Windows retained-module adapter. The future NPU certification adapter must reuse this owner rather than adding another Unix capture or sealing service.
